reviews.title: The best..
reviews.text:
I’m using Storm Shield since many years and it’s simply the best. Just this morning the app informed me that a brief rain shower would occur at 6:57am - at exactly at 6:57 it started raining for about 3 minutes. Do I have to say more?

The latest price increase from $1.49 per month to &6.49 per month is ridiculous. What do we get more out of the app with this 500% increase?
I have to bite in this apple as I need StormShield during our hurricane season but still I think it’s ridiculous.

reviews.title: Do Not Download - Money Hungry Developers
reviews.text:
I have been a loyal customer since the app launched.  It was my favorite and the best for future radar watches.  It helped with Tornado tracking in my area and having the ability to warn my local family.  This App has increased its fees from yearly to monthly to weekly at ridiculous levels, especially in a time where everything else is ridiculously expensive… $30 a year, $12 a month, $1.99 a week adds up quick

I have deleted the app and moved on

You think they would Grandfather the loyal customers in that helped make what the app good like it once was with the small team of determined developers that focused on the customer satisfaction and amazing weather information it provided.  Instead, the new owners are more interested in ‘pleasing and lining the stock holders pockets’ first and bending everyone over a log while stroking a dry corn cob right up where the sun don’t shine 

This app is a blundering joke and I hope all others follow along to the point it has to shut down.

reviews.title: New developer firm is greedy
reviews.text:
I first downloaded this app several years ago when it’s original owners and developers had it. Living in Iowa, severe weather is a thing and promptness, accuracy and reliability are THE key attributes for a severe weather alerting app to demonstrate. Storm Shield ticked all three boxes for years both in Iowa and for the brief time I lived in another state. Like some of the reviews suggest, I was impressed by the fact that the app would push an alert before other outlets or outdoor warning sirens. Didn’t matter if the alert was related to convective weather, winter weather, high winds or fog…Storm Shield was always ahead of the game-and at a very reasonable price. $.99/mo for everything. Granted one doesn’t have to purchase any upgrades in order to get the key functionality which is the alerting. What I am floored by is how the current developer can justify such an up charge to $11.49+? What is the true value proposition that warrants increasing price from $.99, to $5 or 6, to what it is today?? 
Not only is this monthly cost not practical, I have noticed that the reliability and timeliness of the app to alert has declined. Sometimes it is delayed significantly but many times it doesn’t even alert when it should. This decline while the cost increases leads me to only one conclusion: the development and ownership folks care more about profit than the consumer experience.

Today’s daily “daily view” showed thunderstorms but the hourly details showed only showed a very low chance of rain. Tomorrow’s daily view is cloudy but the hourly details shows a very high chance of rain.  If the daily view is all I have time to look at I’m going to be disappointed by your lack accuracy often.

reviews.title: Was mediocre but got worse
reviews.text:
I originally got this app because of the degree to which it would let you customize the alerts. However, that was iffy and when I would write to the support team, if I got an answer at all, it would be something vague about an alert type not being supported by the backend. (Take it out of the app, maybe?)

Unfortunately, the app developers haven’t kept up with the times.

Despite being a weather alerts app, they never added critical notification support. (Thanks)

Additionally, the team hasn’t kept up with the changes in weather event codes, or changes to NOAA’s alerting API. This is why you get random alerts that don’t appear when you click on them, or for alert types you’ve disabled. It also mutes alert types it doesn’t know about, which is increasingly common due to the lack of updates.  There are better options out there.

reviews.title: No weather video anymore?

reviews.title: Downgrade

reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for many years. When a push notification comes through with a weather alert, it can take up to 30 minutes to see the alert. When you tap on the notification and it takes you to the app it will say 0 alerts. This could affect someone’s safety. reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: As others have recently mentioned, the app is no longer working as it had in the past. I’m getting notifications coming through but when opening the app to find out more, there’s nothing there. However, just today, a Winter Weather Advisory was declared and I never received a notification at all, even though I have it checked, and nothing was showing in the app either. I only found out about it through my local news/weather app. This used to be a top notch weather app I could always count on, but it is no longer reliable and I wouldn’t bet my life on it during a severe weather outbreak. Get it fixed please or it’s going in the trash.

reviews.title: What happened? (June 2025)
reviews.text:
Ever since the last update, not the one today, the temperature and feels like has been reading the same even though the dewpoint are in the mid to upper 60s, and also the warning that we are getting (I live in Michigan) is showing for Canada and reading in Celsius. I just did the new update and it did not correct any of that. Yesterday I also tried turning my phone off for a bit turning it back on, that didn’t do anything for the app. I also uninstalled the app and reinstalled the app, and it didn’t fix the problem either.
**Update: Alerts still showing Celsius and for Canada. PLEASE FIX THIS or I will be canceling my overpriced subscription.
***Another update: the quality and notifications were better when it was the $.99 or dollar or something a month, but now I pay yearly to save on money and the quality is worse and it’s still showing for Michigan in Canadian terms like millimeters centimeters and Celsius instead of Fahrenheit. I like to know why I’m paying this much money, and I’m getting the wrong measurements for my country. This needs to be fixed. It’s ridiculous.

reviews.title: Quality has plummeted.
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for at least 5+ years & it has become useless & expensive. The forecast showing weather across the day conflicts dramatically with that shown for the week. For example, today the conflicting temp forecasts are off by 20 degrees from each other. Sometimes one shows sun while the other shows storms. The 2 forecasts rarely match or are even close. I am currently looking for a better weather app & anticipate canceling this one. I do not recommend it!
